Repeatedly hit and fixed the same git mistake this session: `git commit -m ... -- <pathspec>` still commits the FULL current diff of that file, not just intended hunks, when other unrelated content is sitting unstaged/uncommitted in the same file — caught it twice (agent_rust_builder.py, types.ts-adjacent files) via git-show-after-commit checks and fixed via git reset --soft + restore-file + reapply-just-my-edit. Always verify a commit's actual diff after making it when the repo has other known-uncommitted content in the same files.
